families.meaning: Cross-channel statistic of the maximum absolute change between adjacent samples
families.quality_interpretation: Highly sensitive to spikes, abrupt jumps, and incompletely removed high-frequency transient artifacts; larger values usually indicate lower quality.
families.cost_note: Low cost; suitable for long-duration multi-channel data.

families.meaning: Skewness of the spectral amplitude distribution
families.quality_interpretation: Reflects whether spectral energy is dominated by a few frequency or artifact peaks.
families.cost_note: Moderately low cost; requires FFT/spectral-domain features.

families.meaning: Kurtosis of the spectral amplitude distribution
families.quality_interpretation: Reflects spectral peakiness; sensitive to narrow-band interference and anomalous frequency components.
families.cost_note: Moderately low cost; requires FFT/spectral-domain features.

families.quality_interpretation: Reflects increased overall dynamic range due to large oscillations, drift, or abnormal channels.
Characterizes long-range correlation and non-stationary structure.
families.cost_note: High-cost candidate; not recommended for the fast primary model until optimized.
